title: Daniel Sharp (product manager, ITX Corp): Incorruptible is 'such an important book for this time in our business history'
summary: Product manager Daniel Sharp calls Incorruptible an important book for this moment, with something for founders, leaders, individual contributors and consumers.
blockquote: Incorruptible is such an important book for this time in our business history. There's something here for founders, leaders, individual contributors, and consumers. I can't recommend it highly enough.
